title: Past perfect: review
instructionEs: Preguntas mezcladas de toda la unidad.

items.prompt: By the time I got to the party, everyone ___.
items.explanationEs: Se fueron antes de que yo llegara: had + participio (left).

items.prompt: She was exhausted because she ___ all night.
items.explanationEs: Algo que llevaba tiempo pasando hasta un momento del pasado: had been + -ing.

items.statement: When I phoned him, he had already gone to bed.
items.explanationEs: Se acostó antes de mi llamada: had gone.

items.statement: They hadn't never seen snow before.
items.explanationEs: Sin doble negación: They had never seen snow (o They hadn't ever seen snow).

answers: How long had you been waiting?
items.explanationEs: Pregunta: how long + had + sujeto + been + -ing.

items.text: I ___ (never / be) on a plane before that holiday.
items.explanationEs: Experiencia hasta un momento del pasado: had + never + participio (been).

items.sentence: We had already ate when they arrived.
items.explanationEs: Después de had, el participio de eat: eaten.
